articles.headline: Vanderbilt recovers fumble with 1 second left to stun NC State
articles.description: The Vanderbilt Commodores pulled off their own Music City Miracle on Saturday with a stunning 35-31, last-second comeback victory over NC State.

images.name: Vanderbilt [600x400]
images.caption: Commodores WR Cole Adams (7), WR LeBron Hill (85), and running back Makhilyn Young (22) celebrate after the Commodores recovered a fumble in the end zone giving Vanderbilt a 35-31 victory.

articles.headline: Nearly 40-point favorite Boston College avoids embarrassing loss; holds off Maine 22-16
articles.description: — Evans Dickens ran for a 39-yard touchdown, Mason McKenzie added a 31-yard scoring pass and Boston College slogged its way to a 22-16 non-conference victory over Maine on Saturday.

articles.headline: Vanderbilt stuns N.C. State with fumble recovery in end zone for improbable 35-31 win
articles.description: — Miles Capers forced the fumble and Cayden Daniels recovered just before time expired to give Vanderbilt a stunning 35-31 win over N.C. State on Saturday.

images.name: Miles Capers relives Vanderbilt's game-saving recovery
images.caption: Capers explains how Vanderbilt's finish-the-game mindset fueled his last-second fumble recovery, sealing a dramatic victory for the Commodores over NC State.
